text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling after sharp declines and later buying back at higher prices has hurt my results; I should follow consistent rules rather than react to short-term moves.","Before adding to a position, I should assess its outlook, portfolio role, and risk—not buy simply because the price moved or because I want to recover a loss.","I should judge progress by long-run account returns against the market, while maintaining diversification and enough cash to make deliberate decisions."]}
